# Reference analysis dependencies

- dr_libs: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs — commit `dfe8377631000664666519fdb83da193fd8037f4`. Vendored `dr_wav.h`, `dr_flac.h`, `dr_mp3.h` and LICENSE. Decoding only; WAV/AIFF, FLAC and MP3.
- r8brain-free-src: https://github.com/avaneev/r8brain-free-src — commit `9e73d2dd59fd5b95108fdb4f590083e35758b45f`. Vendored portable headers and FFT sources, with LICENSE. Uses the default Ooura backend.

Sample rate converter designed by Aleksey Vaneev of Voxengo.
